title: Pachymic acid protects hepatic cells against oxygen-glucose deprivation/reperfusion injury by activating sirtuin 1 to inhibit HMGB1 acetylation and inflammatory signaling.
authors: Xue, Chengbiao; Xu, Zhigao; Liu, Zhongzhong; Zeng, Cheng; Ye, Qifa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茯苓酸通过SIRT1抑制HMGB1乙酰化减轻肝细胞缺血再灌注损伤，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ischemia-reperfusion injury is an important cause of liver injury occurring during liver transplantation. It is usually caused by inflammatory response and oxidative stress-induced oxidative damage. Pachymic acid (PA) has various biological activities such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and anti-cancer. However, the action mechanism of PA in hepatic ischemia-reperfusion injury is currently unknown. In this study, liver cells were subjected to oxygen-glucose deprivation/reperfusion (OGD/R) to simulate a hepatic ischemia-reperfusion injury model. The binding relationship between PA and sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) was analyzed by molecular docking. Cell viability was detected by Cell Counting Kit-8. Expression levels of SIRT1 and high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) were detected by western blot. Subsequent levels of inflammatory factors were detected by related kits and western blot. Meanwhile, related kits were used to examine levels of oxidative stress markers including reactive oxygen species, malondialdehyde, superoxide dismutase and cytotoxicity-associated lactate dehydrogenase. Finally, cell apoptosis was detected by flow cytometry and western blot. The results showed that PA significantly ameliorated OGD/R-induced decrease in SIRT1 expression, increase in HMGB1 acetylation and HMGB1 translocation. Moreover, the elevated levels of inflammatory factors, oxidative stress indexes and cell apoptosis upon exposure to OGD/R were reversed by PA treatment. Moreover, the addition of SIRT1 agonist and inhibitor further demonstrated that PA exerted the aforementioned effects in OGD/R-exposed cells by targeting SIRT1. Thus, the present study revealed the mechanism by which PA ameliorated OGD/R-induced hepatic injury via SIRT1. These results might provide a clearer theoretical basis for the targeted treatment of OGD/R-induced hepatic injury with PA.
abstract_zh: 缺血再灌注损伤是肝移植过程中发生肝损伤的重要原因，通常由炎症反应和氧化应激诱导的氧化损伤引起。茯苓酸（Pachymic acid, PA）具有抗炎、抗氧化和抗癌等多种生物活性。然而，PA在肝脏缺血再灌注损伤中的作用机制目前尚不清楚。本研究对肝细胞进行氧糖剥夺/再灌注（oxygen-glucose deprivation/reperfusion, OGD/R）处理，以模拟肝脏缺血再灌注损伤模型。通过分子对接分析PA与去乙酰化酶1（sirtuin 1, SIRT1）之间的结合关系。使用细胞计数试剂盒-8检测细胞活力。通过蛋白质印迹法检测SIRT1和高迁移率族蛋白B1（high mobility group box 1, HMGB1）的表达水平。随后，使用相关试剂盒和蛋白质印迹法检测炎症因子水平。同时，使用相关试剂盒检测氧化应激标志物水平，包括活性氧、丙二醛、超氧化物歧化酶和细胞毒性相关的乳酸脱氢酶。最后，通过流式细胞术和蛋白质印迹法检测细胞凋亡。结果表明，PA显著改善了OGD/R诱导的SIRT1表达下降、HMGB1乙酰化增加及HMGB1转位。此外，OGD/R暴露后升高的炎症因子水平、氧化应激指标和细胞凋亡均被PA处理逆转。进一步添加SIRT1激动剂和抑制剂证明，PA通过靶向SIRT1在OGD/R暴露细胞中发挥上述作用。因此，本研究揭示了PA通过SIRT1改善OGD/R诱导肝损伤的机制。这些结果可能为PA靶向治疗OGD/R诱导的肝损伤提供更清晰的理论基础。
